info.title: Stophammer API
info.description: Generated OpenAPI document for the custom Stophammer API explorer.

get.description: Liveness probe that returns plain text `ok`.

post.description: Crawler submission endpoint. Validates the feed through the verifier chain and writes accepted changes atomically. The crawl token is supplied in the JSON body.

200.description: Ingest result. A `source_conflict` reason (ADR 0051 section 5) also carries `source_url`, the stored source URL of the held record. A `guid_change_pending` or `guid_change_rejected` reason (ADR 0052 section 4) means the source URL declares a GUID other than the one the record holds. A GUID-change transition (ADR 0052 section 5), run either for the UUIDv5 of the source URL or for an operator approval, names its old and new GUID in `warnings`: `GUID changed from <old> to <new> (ADR 0052 UUIDv5)` or `(ADR 0052 approved)`. A `source_blocked` reason (ADR 0057 sections 2 and 3) means the source URL matches a `podcast:block` tag that applies to this index. A request with no `feed_data` and an `http_status` of `404` or `410` reports a gone source URL (ADR 0067). A counted report gets the reason `source_gone_observed` on its first answer, or `source_gone` on a second answer 24 hours or more after the first, which retires the record. Each other gone report gets `source_gone_ignored` and changes nothing.

get.description: Returns this node's ed25519 public key.
Paginated event log for community nodes to poll.
Returns all known active peer nodes.

post.description: Set-diff catch-up for nodes rejoining after downtime.
Community nodes announce their push URL to the primary. The primary verifies same-origin ownership through `GET /node/info` and stores the peer for future fan-out.

422.description: Rejected node URL or ownership verification failed.

example.error: Rejected node URL or ownership verification failed.

get.description: Lists every feed-block row, in `blocked_at` order.

post.description: Blocks a feed GUID or an exact feed URL from ingest (ADR 0053 section 1). A pair the table already holds changes nothing and answers `409` with the existing `block_id`.

409.description: The kind/value pair already has a block.

delete.description: Removes a `feed_blocks` row and signs a `FeedUnblocked` event (ADR 0053 section 1). A missing row signs nothing.

get.summary: List records with an open copy
get.description: Returns each record that has at least one open ADR 0058 copy, or a copies_over_limit counter above zero, newest first.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum rows to return, at most 100.

200.description: Paginated list of records with an open copy.

get.description: Lists source feeds in recent-source order for provenance and debugging workflows.

parameters.name: medium
parameters.description: Optional feed medium filter. Defaults to `music`. Use `all` for every medium.

parameters.name: stated_rel
parameters.description: With `medium=publisher`: keep only the rows with this role token in `stated_rels`. The value is lowercased (ADR 0068 sections 4 and 5). Gives the link facts.

parameters.name: two_way_links
parameters.description: With `medium=publisher`: `none` keeps only the rows with `two_way_link_count` 0 (ADR 0068 section 4). Gives the link facts.

get.description: Returns a single feed by its `feed_guid`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor for included nested collections.

parameters.name: medium
parameters.description: Optional medium override used by shared query parsing.

404.description: Feed not found. Carries `superseded_by`, the GUID that replaced this one, when a GUID-change transition retired it (ADR 0052 section 5).

delete.description: Retires a feed and cascade-deletes its dependent data. In the same transaction, this also blocks the feed GUID and the stored feed URL (ADR 0053 section 1), unless `block=false` asks for no block.

parameters.name: block
parameters.description: Defaults to `true`. When `false`, retires with no block. Only the admin token may send `block=false`.

patch.description: Updates a feed's mutable fields. Currently supports `feed_url` only, which relocates the record (ADR 0058 section 5). A relocation needs `reason`, and clears `last_build_date` and `declared_self_url`.

requestBody.description: JSON Merge Patch payload. `reason` is required when `feed_url` is present.

example.reason: confirmed move to the new host

400.description: feed_url is present with no reason, or an empty reason.

example.error: feed_url is present with no reason, or an empty reason.

409.description: Another record already holds feed_url as its source URL.

example.error: Another record already holds feed_url as its source URL.

get.description: Returns each row of the ADR 0058 feed-copy summary of a feed: the URL, the two differences against the current record, guid_origin, the item titles and image, and the resolution when one exists.

post.description: The operator keeps the source or relocates the record to the copy's URL (ADR 0058 section 4). `relocate` calls the same relocation as `PATCH /v1/feeds/{guid}`: it clears `last_build_date` and `declared_self_url`, and signs a `FeedUpserted` event before the `FeedCopyResolved` event.

example.reason: confirmed this is an impersonation; keeping the held record

200.description: Resolution applied. `event_ids` has one entry for `keep_source`, and two — `FeedUpserted` then `FeedCopyResolved` — for `relocate`.

400.description: Empty reason, or decision is not "keep_source" or "relocate".

example.error: Empty reason, or decision is not "keep_source" or "relocate".

404.description: Feed not found, or it has no copy row at that url.

example.error: Feed not found, or it has no copy row at that url.

409.description: decision is "relocate" and another record already holds the copy's url as its source URL.

example.error: decision is "relocate" and another record already holds the copy's url as its source URL.

post.description: The operator approves or rejects a pending GUID change (ADR 0052 section 4). `{guid}` is the old GUID the pending row names. The node does not keep the body of the submission that opened the row: `approve` only sets the decision, and the transition runs at the next submission of the new GUID from the source URL.

parameters.name: guid
parameters.description: The old GUID a pending row names.

400.description: Empty reason, or decision is not "approve" or "reject".

example.error: Empty reason, or decision is not "approve" or "reject".

404.description: No pending GUID change names this GUID as its old GUID.

example.error: No pending GUID change names this GUID as its old GUID.

get.description: Returns each change of the payment recipients of a feed and its tracks, read from the signed event log (ADR 0053 section 4).

200.description: Route-history entries, in `seq` order, the newest last.

404.description: No event names a route set of this feed.

example.error: No event names a route set of this feed.

get.description: Canonical track lookup by parent `feed_guid` plus raw source `track_guid`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor for included nested collections.

404.description: Track not found in the specified feed.

example.error: Track not found in the specified feed.

delete.description: Deletes a single track from its parent feed.

404.description: Track not found or does not belong to the feed.

example.error: Track not found or does not belong to the feed.

patch.summary: Patch track by feed and GUID
patch.description: Canonical mutation route for a track scoped by parent `feed_guid` and raw source `track_guid`. Currently supports `enclosure_url` only.

404.description: Track not found in the specified feed.

example.error: Track not found in the specified feed.

get.description: Returns each pending GUID change with no `reject` decision, newest `first_seen` first (ADR 0052 section 4).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum rows to return, at most 100.

200.description: Paginated list of pending GUID changes.

get.description: Returns the live-event rows of every public feed, with feed_guid, paged by feed_guid then live_item_guid (ADR 0064 section 6). `view` picks `now` (the default), `upcoming` or `all`; the raw filters status, live_value, ends_after and starts_after apply only with view=all.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: With view=all only: pending, live or ended.

parameters.name: live_value
parameters.description: With view=all only: set or none.

parameters.name: ends_after
parameters.description: With view=all only: Unix seconds. Selects rows whose scheduled_end is after this time.

parameters.name: starts_after
parameters.description: With view=all only: Unix seconds. Selects rows whose scheduled_start is after this time.

400.description: Unknown view, unknown filter value, a raw filter with a view other than all, or an invalid cursor.

example.error: Unknown view, unknown filter value, a raw filter with a view other than all, or an invalid cursor.

get.description: Returns API version, capabilities, supported entity types, and valid include parameters.
Lists all known peer nodes from the public peer table.
Gives the number of listed publisher links, by resolution: `guid`, `feed_url` or `unresolved`. ADR 0049 section 8.
Lists non-empty publisher text values with feed and track counts.

parameters.name: case_sensitive
parameters.description: Set to `true` for case-sensitive matching. Defaults to `false`.

get.description: Returns feeds and tracks whose stored publisher text contains the path parameter. Matching is partial (substring); case-insensitive by default.

parameters.name: case_sensitive
parameters.description: Set to `true` for case-sensitive matching. Defaults to `false`.

Returns all tracks whose `track_artist` matches the given name (case-insensitive). Paginated newest-first.

parameters.name: artist
parameters.description: Artist name to filter by (case-insensitive exact match).

example.error: track_guid track-guid is ambiguous; retry with the canonical feed-scoped route

release_artist_source.description:
The source of `release_artist`: `itunes_author`, `itunes_owner`, or
`placeholder`. Null when no ingest has run since migration 0037. ADR
0049 §5.

BlockConflictBody.description:
Response body for a `409 Conflict` from `POST /v1/blocks`: the
`block_id` of the row that already blocks this pair.

CoCreditedFeedResponse.description:
One entry of `co_credited_feeds` (ADR 0069 §4): a publisher feed that
shares one or more confirmed albums with the feed that the client reads.

album_count.description: The number of shared confirmed albums.

roles.description:
The different raw `rel` values that the shared albums give that feed,
sorted. Empty when no album states one.

title.description:
The title of that publisher feed, or null when the node holds no feed
for it.

CopyRecordResponse.description:
One item of `GET /v1/copies` (ADR 0058 Section 3): a record with at
least one open copy, or with a `copies_over_limit` counter above zero.

copies_over_limit.description: Local to the primary. `0` on a community node.

copy_count.description: The number of open copies of this record.

newest_first_seen.description:
The newest `first_seen` of an open copy of this record. Null when
the record has no open copy, which happens only when it is listed
solely for a `copies_over_limit` above zero.

FeedBlock.description:
A row that blocks one feed GUID or one exact feed URL.

ADR 0053 Section 1. The primary makes `block_id` as a UUID and carries it
in the `FeedBlocked` event, so every node holds the same row under the
same identity.

FeedBlockKind.description:
The kind of value a [`FeedBlock`] names: a `podcast:guid` or an exact URL.

ADR 0053 Section 1. A GUID value is stored and compared in lower case. A
URL value is stored and compared as the exact trimmed string.

FeedCopiesResponse.description:
Envelope of `GET /v1/feeds/{guid}/copies`. It carries one extra field
beyond the shared [`QueryResponse`] envelope: `copies_over_limit`, the
ADR 0058 Section 1a counter of this GUID. Local to the primary; `0` on a
community node.

FeedCopyResolutionResponse.description:
The resolution of one `feed_copies` row (ADR 0058 Section 4). `current`
is true while the resolution's digest still matches the row's own
digest; a changed summary makes the copy open again with `current: false`.

guid_origin.description:
True when this URL's GUID is the `UUIDv5` of the URL itself, and not
of the record's stored source URL (ADR 0058 Section 1b).

last_seen.description: Local to the primary. Null on a community node.

open.description: True when the row differs and has no resolution that holds.

rel.description:
Raw `rel` attribute. The Podcast Namespace does not define `rel` on
`podcast:remoteItem`, so this value is non-standard.

remote_feed_image_url.description:
The image URL of the named feed, or null when the node holds no feed
for this entry. Passed through `web_url_or_none`. ADR 0059 §3.

remote_feed_title.description:
The title of the named feed, or null when the node holds no feed for
this entry. ADR 0059 §1.

remote_item_guid.description:
The `itemGuid` of the track this entry names, or null when the entry
has no `itemGuid`. Always present. ADR 0060 §3.

remote_item_title.description:
The `title` of the track this entry names, or null when the entry
has no `title`. Always present. ADR 0060 §3.

remote_release_artist.description:
The release artist of the named feed, or null when the node holds no
feed for this entry. ADR 0059 §1.

remote_release_artist_source.description:
The release artist source of the named feed, or null when the node
holds no feed for this entry. ADR 0059 §1.

remote_track_duration_secs.description: The stored duration of that track in seconds, or null. ADR 0059 §5.

remote_track_guid.description:
The `track_guid` of the indexed track that this entry names, or null
when no such track is indexed. Always present. ADR 0060 §3.

remote_track_image_url.description:
The stored image of that item, not a resolved image, or null. Only a
web URL reaches the client (ADR 0054 §4). ADR 0059 §5.

remote_track_title.description:
The stored `title` of the track that `remote_track_guid` names, or
null when `remote_track_guid` is null. ADR 0059 §5.

agreed_roles.description:
The role tokens of the confirmed rows that both sides state, with
`role_agreement` `both`, sorted. Present only where
`two_way_link_count` is. ADR 0068 §5.

co_credited_feeds.description:
Each other publisher feed that a confirmed album of this publisher
feed also confirms. Present only on a read of a publisher feed with
`include=publisher`. ADR 0069 §4.

confirmed_release_artist_count.description:
The count of `confirmed_release_artists`.

The value is derived, not stored. It counts only a listed album that
also names this feed as its publisher. Present only when this feed is
a publisher feed. ADR 0061 §1.

confirmed_release_artists.description:
One raw `remote_release_artist` value for each count in
`confirmed_release_artist_count`, in the order of first listing.

The value is derived, not stored. It counts only a listed album that
also names this feed as its publisher. Present only when this feed is
a publisher feed. ADR 0061 §1.

copy_count.description:
The number of open copies of this feed (ADR 0058 sections 2 to 4).
`GET /v1/feeds/{guid}/copies` lists them.

distinct_release_artist_count.description:
The number of distinct album artists of a publisher feed.

The value is derived, not stored. It counts only an album whose
`release_artist` comes from `itunes:author`. A "feat." credit can
count as a different artist. Present only when this feed is a
publisher feed. ADR 0049 §7.

distinct_release_artists.description:
One raw `release_artist` value for each count in
`distinct_release_artist_count`, sorted by the normalized value.

The value is derived, not stored. It counts only an album whose
`release_artist` comes from `itunes:author`. A "feat." credit can
count as a different artist. Present only when this feed is a
publisher feed. ADR 0049 §7.

live_items.description:
Every stored live-item row of this feed, sorted by `live_item_guid`
(ADR 0064 section 6).

Present on `GET /v1/feeds/{guid}`: always `Some`, possibly an empty
list. Absent on `GET /v1/feeds/recent`, since ADR 0064 section 6
scopes this field to the single-feed read; an empty list there would
wrongly state that the feed has no live item.

oneOf.description:
Null, or the pending GUID change the source URL of this feed
declares (ADR 0052 section 4). `decision` is null until the operator
decides, then `approve` or `reject`.

publisher_feed_title.description:
The title of the feed this album names as its publisher.

Derived when the node reads this feed: the feed's own
`medium="publisher"` remote item at the lowest position, resolved
with [`db::resolve_listed_feed`]. Null when the feed names no
publisher or the resolver cannot place it. ADR 0049 §5.

release_artist_source.description:
The source of `release_artist`: `itunes_author`, `itunes_owner`, or
`placeholder`. Null when no ingest has run since migration 0037. ADR
0049 §5.

stated_rels.description:
The different role tokens of the `publisher_rel` values of those
confirmed rows, lowercased and sorted. Present only where
`two_way_link_count` is. ADR 0068 §5.

two_way_link_count.description:
The count of confirmed album links of a publisher feed: the
`publisher_to_music` rows of the `publisher` view with
`two_way_validated` true and a `role_agreement` that is not
`conflict`. Present only on a publisher row of
`GET /v1/feeds/recent` with `include=link_facts`. ADR 0068 §1 and
ADR 0049 §6a.

unconfirmed_release_artist_count.description:
The count of `unconfirmed_release_artists`.

The value is derived, not stored. It counts only a listed album that
does not name this feed as its publisher. Present only when this feed
is a publisher feed. ADR 0061 §1.

unconfirmed_release_artists.description:
One raw `remote_release_artist` value for each count in
`unconfirmed_release_artist_count`, in the order of first listing.

The value is derived, not stored. It counts only a listed album that
does not name this feed as its publisher. Present only when this feed
is a publisher feed. ADR 0061 §1.

FeedSupersededBody.description:
Body of a `404` for `GET /v1/feeds/{guid}` naming a superseded GUID (ADR
0052 section 5, task 007).

superseded_by.description: The GUID that replaced the one named in the path.

GuidChangeDecisionResponse.description: Response body for a decided GUID change.

GuidChangeResponse.description:
One row of `GET /v1/guid-changes` (ADR 0052 section 4, task 007): a
pending GUID change with no `reject` decision.

last_seen.description: Local to the primary. Null on a community node.

IngestResponse.description: Response returned to the crawler after a `POST /ingest/feed` attempt.

accepted.description: `true` when the submission was accepted and written to the database.

events_emitted.description: UUIDs of events emitted during this ingest, in emission order.

no_change.description: `true` when content hash matched the cache and no write was performed.

reason.description: Rejection reason when `accepted` is `false`; `None` on success.

source_url.description:
The source URL of the held record, present only with a
`source_conflict` reason (ADR 0051 section 5).

warnings.description: Non-fatal verifier warnings recorded alongside the events.

LiveItemListResponse.description:
One row of `GET /v1/live-items`: the same shape as a `live_items` row of
`GET /v1/feeds/{guid}`, plus `feed_guid` (ADR 0064 section 6).

in_now_view.description:
`true` when the `now` view gives this row at the time of the read
(ADR 0064 section 6). Computed with `live::in_now_view`.

in_upcoming_view.description:
`true` when the `upcoming` view gives this row at the time of the
read (ADR 0064 section 6). Computed with `live::in_upcoming_view`.

confirming_relay.description:
`true` when `live_value_uri` names a relay on a host of
`CONFIRMING_RELAY_HOSTS` (ADR 0064 section 3).

in_now_view.description:
`true` when the `now` view gives this row at the time of the read
(ADR 0064 section 6). Computed with `live::in_now_view`.

in_upcoming_view.description:
`true` when the `upcoming` view gives this row at the time of the
read (ADR 0064 section 6). Computed with `live::in_upcoming_view`.

live_value_uri.description:
The relay `uri` of the `podcast:liveValue` element. A `uri` with a
scheme goes through the web URL rule (ADR 0054 section 4); a bare
identifier, with no scheme, is given as it is.

PendingGuidChangeResponse.description:
The pending GUID change of `FeedResponse.pending_guid_change` (ADR 0052
section 4, task 007).

last_seen.description: Local to the primary. Null on a community node.

PublisherLinkStatsResponse.description:
The counts `GET /v1/publisher-links/stats` gives (ADR 0049 §8, plan
decision 9). `listed_links` is the sum of the other three fields.

album_names_as.description:
How the album names this publisher feed: `"publisher"`, `"credit"` or
null. ADR 0069 §3. On a `music_to_publisher` row, the value comes from
the album's own item. On a `publisher_to_music` row, it comes from the
album item that names this publisher feed, and it is null when
`music_names_publisher` is false.

music_names_publisher.description: The album names this publisher feed. ADR 0049 §4.

music_rel.description:
Raw `rel` of the `medium="publisher"` item, on the album feed, that
names this publisher. Null when that item is missing or has no
`rel`. A comma separates two or more roles in this raw value.

The Podcast Namespace does not define `rel` on `podcast:remoteItem`,
so this value is non-standard. ADR 0049 §6.

publisher_link_observed_at.description:
The time of the URL observation behind `publisher_link_resolution`.
Null unless that value is `"feed_url"`. ADR 0049 §3.

publisher_link_resolution.description:
How the node resolved the feed that carries `publisher_lists_music`:
`"guid"`, `"feed_url"` or `"unresolved"`. ADR 0049 §3.

publisher_lists_music.description: The publisher feed lists this album, by any resolution. ADR 0049 §4.

publisher_rel.description:
Raw `rel` of the `medium="music"` item, on the publisher feed, that
lists this album. Null when that item is missing or has no `rel`.
A comma separates two or more roles in this raw value.

The Podcast Namespace does not define `rel` on `podcast:remoteItem`,
so this value is non-standard. ADR 0049 §6.

remote_feed_image_url.description:
The image URL of the named feed, or null when the node holds no feed
for this entry. Passed through `web_url_or_none`. ADR 0059 §3.

remote_feed_title.description:
The title of the named feed, or null when the node holds no feed for
this entry. ADR 0059 §1.

remote_release_artist.description:
The release artist of the named feed, or null when the node holds no
feed for this entry. ADR 0059 §1.

remote_release_artist_source.description:
The release artist source of the named feed, or null when the node
holds no feed for this entry. ADR 0059 §1.

role.description:
The role set, sorted and joined by `", "`. Null when neither side
states one, and null on a conflict between the two role sets. ADR
0049 §6, amended on 2026-10-02: the node gives no guess.

role_agreement.description:
Whether the two sides agree on the role: `"both"`, `"one_side"`,
`"conflict"`, or null when no side states one. ADR 0049 §6a. A row
with `"conflict"` is not a confirmed link.

ResolveCopyResponse.description:
Response body for a resolved copy: the IDs of every event the resolution
signed, in the order they were signed. `relocate` signs a `FeedUpserted`
and a `FeedCopyResolved`; `keep_source` signs only the latter.

RouteHistoryEntry.description:
One row of `GET /v1/feeds/{guid}/route-history` (ADR 0053 Section 4).

Written only when the recipient set of `subject` differs from the last
set recorded for it. `track_guid` is `None` for the feed itself.
`old_recipients` is `None` for the first set recorded for that subject.

RouteHistorySubject.description: Which entity a [`RouteHistoryEntry`] reports a recipient-set change for.

RouteRecipient.description:
One recipient of a payment-route set: an address, its keysend custom
record, and its split.

The route-history read of ADR 0053 Section 4 compares an ordered list of
these to decide whether a payment change occurred. A keysend route to a
shared node names the account in `custom_key` and `custom_value`, so a
change of either one sends the payment to a different recipient. The set
excludes the name, the route type and `fee`.

href.description:
Null when the raw source value's scheme is not `http` or `https`
(ADR 0054 section 4).

img.description:
Null when the raw source value's scheme is not `http` or `https`
(ADR 0054 section 4).

url.description:
Null when the raw source value's scheme is not `http` or `https`
(ADR 0054 section 4).

Null when the raw source value's scheme is not `http` or `https`
(ADR 0054 section 4).

Null when the raw source value's scheme is not `http` or `https`
(ADR 0054 section 4).

Null when the raw source value's scheme is not `http` or `https`
(ADR 0054 section 4).

rel.description:
Raw `rel` attribute. The Podcast Namespace does not define `rel` on
`podcast:remoteItem`, so this value is non-standard.

remote_feed_image_url.description:
The image URL of the named feed, or null when the node holds no feed
for this entry. Passed through `web_url_or_none`. ADR 0059 §3.

remote_feed_title.description:
The title of the named feed, or null when the node holds no feed for
this entry. ADR 0059 §1.

remote_release_artist.description:
The release artist of the named feed, or null when the node holds no
feed for this entry. ADR 0059 §1.

remote_release_artist_source.description:
The release artist source of the named feed, or null when the node
holds no feed for this entry. ADR 0059 §1.

release_artist_source.description:
The source of `release_artist`: `itunes_author`, `itunes_owner`, or
`placeholder`. Null when no ingest has run since migration 0037. ADR
0049 §5.
